transcript.text: Hi, it’s Cadence calling to check in. Have you noticed your heart racing, hands feeling shaky, or feeling hot or sweaty when other people don’t?
No racing heart or shaky hands. I do get kind of hot and sweaty when everyone else seems fine, figured it was just me.
Thanks for telling me — have you had any trouble sleeping, or noticed any weight loss without trying?
Yeah, sleep’s been a bit rough, lots of tossing and turning. My weight’s about the same.

Thanks — with feeling hot when others aren’t and rough sleep, the advice is: “If you notice your heart racing, shaky hands, feeling hot or sweaty, trouble sleeping, or losing weight without trying, contact your GP — these can mean the dose needs looking at.” Would you be able to let your GP know today?
